text: There are people with dreams they haven't forgotten, ideas they still believe in, and plans they've been meaning to start.
But somewhere between preparing and doing, life gets in the way.
Meet Belinda Bright N., independent author of The Life You Keep Planning.
Her debut book explores why we overthink, chase new ideas and struggle to follow through.
But it doesn't stop at understanding the problem.
It introduces practical tools, including the SELECT method and a thirty-day follow-through programme.
Because you don't need to do everything.
You need to give what matters a fair chance.
The Life You Keep Planning. Available from the twenty-third of January, twenty twenty-seven.
